name: app-dating-app-screens-in-berry-pink-gradients
title: Six dating app screens in raspberry gradients: streaks, premium plans, match compatibility and voice memo
whatItIs: Six phones on white with soft berry swooshes. Screens include a flame streak card with daily reward rows, a profile with premium cards, a match result with a compatibility bar and 'this or that' answers, a voice memo profile, a like-limit modal and a plan picker with selectable pricing rows.
whatItMeans: Warm and playful; berry gradients on white feel romantic without clutter.
techniques: Use one berry gradient for premium elements.
Show rewards as check rows for a streak.
Present pricing as selectable rows with save badges.
Add a waveform for voice memos.

vocabulary.definition: A special gradient marking paid features.
